_comment: Model catalog shown in Settings -> Models. Read by the app (sizes, languages, ranking) and the server (engine). 'languages': ISO 639-1 codes or ['*'] = all Whisper languages. 'recommended': languages this model is the suggested pick for (['*'] = any). Order = display order inside a group.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo
models.note: Best balance of speed and accuracy. Supports the custom dictionary.

models.name: Whisper Large v3
models.note: Most accurate, especially with mixed-language speech and technical terms. About 2x slower than Turbo.

models.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2
models.note: Very fast with excellent English accuracy. Takes no spelling hint, but dictionary fixes still apply.

models.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
models.note: European languages, detects the language itself. Weak on English words inside other languages. Dictionary fixes only.

models.name: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B (8-bit)
models.note: Strong on Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Writes Latin terms phonetically in other scripts.

models.name: Qwen3-ASR 0.6B (8-bit)
models.note: Smaller Qwen3-ASR for Macs with less memory.

models.name: Whisper Small
models.note: Small download for 8 GB Macs. Noticeably more mistakes.

models.name: Whisper Base
models.note: Tiny. Good for trying the app out, not for daily use.
